title: Mixed Event — Take the Best Shot! — Episode3 A Reliable Helper

meta.Event Outline: For Valentine's Day, Kohane hopes to buy An the chocolates she wants to try, but unfortunately, they're all sold out. Then, she learns that those chocolates are one of the prizes for a Valentine's Day photo contest being held by a makeup brand!

rows.Line: A few days later
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 2-A

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Okay, we'll stop here for today.
Next time we'll be starting by going over your homework assignment, so please make sure to have it complete by then.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (So you're supposed to thoroughly clean your skin first before applying your base makeup...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Wait...
Primer, foundation, concealer...
There's a lot more involved than I thought.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I was hoping to learn what I could during this break, but this is turning out to be really complicated...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But I have to do my best for Aoyagi's sake! I'll just have to go step by step...!)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Kohane, are you free right now?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Huh? Haruka...?
Is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sorry for coming so suddenly, but I came to return that notebook you lent me earlier.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, right... Thanks for bringing it back.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, I should be the one thanking you for writing such beautifully organized notes.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I wouldn't have been able to catch up without it.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad to hear that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: By the way, you had this really serious look on your face while holding...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: A cosmetics magazine...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, umm... This is just...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
No, I'm sorry too.
I was a little surprised is all since you don't usually wear any makeup.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I-It's okay, really.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It's just... One thing led to another and I'm having to do some research on the subject.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Now I see...
You're learning more about makeup for your photo contest entry.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, and I'll be the one doing Aoyagi's makeup...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But on top of everything that I need to get, I have to figure out how to apply it. Which is why I'm starting to get a little worried...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
But for An and Shinonome's sake...
And for Aoyagi's sake since he agreed to help me... I need to cram as much as I can...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then, why don't I lend you a hand?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I learned how to do makeup from a stylist a little while back, so I can try teaching you what I know.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I should also be able to give you some advice when it comes to posing and stuff for your shoot.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wh-What...?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I'd really appreciate it...
But are you sure? Aren't you really busy with work...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You said you're doing your shoot on Saturday, right?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I just happen to have that day off, so I should be able to join you. We have a little more free time now after hiring a manager.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Then, if you don't mind spending part of your day off with us...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'd love to. This is the least I can do since you've been nice enough to share your notes and stuff with me.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Thank you so much...!
I promise to do what I can too.
The day of the shoot
Shopping Mall

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, Haruka, over here...!
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hi, Kohane! And you're Aoyagi, yes...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, it's been a while.
I'm a complete novice when it comes to modelling, so I can't thank you enough for being here.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to working with you today.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Likewise.
I'll do my best to help.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then, can we begin by going over the rules and guidelines for this contest again...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I'd like to go over them again as well.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay! I'll read out what the site says.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Let's see...
“Entrants are required to use cosmetic products by Colore Mi and send in their photos through the entry website listed here.”

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, we're actually allowed to use other brands, but we at the very least have to use Colore Mi for eye shadow and lips...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see. We can discuss that in further detail when we're picking out our cosmetics.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Okay. Anyway, I'll continue...
“The theme of this contest is Valentine's Day.”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Valentine's Day...?
How do you capture that using makeup?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm guessing they want us to capture certain aspects of Valentine's Day through makeup.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: For example, using dark chocolate browns for a more mature look or a combination of pinks to appear more sweet is pretty standard.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Again, we can decide what we're going to do when we're choosing our makeup.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: O-Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm glad we have a professional on our side.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm no makeup artist, but I should at least be able to teach you the basics.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Anyway, Kohane, what comes next?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, uhh...
“Each entrant may submit up to three photos. Entries will be ranked based on the total number of likes they receive.”

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: “Voters may like up to five photos. If one finds a photo they like more, they will be able to reconsider their previous choices.”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see. I was under the impression that the early bird would get the worm...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If people are able to change their votes, then it seems prudent to take the highest quality photos we can.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I agree.
Let's take our time to take the best ones we can.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Remind me again when we have until?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Umm... All photos must be submitted by five this afternoon, and voting will end at nine this evening.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The rankings will be finalized once the likes have been calculated.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see. Which means we'll get to see the results later tonight...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah...!
Only the top ten get prizes, so let's do our best...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Alright, time is of the essence, so let's get started. First, we need to grab some makeup.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The cosmetics department on this floor has a unisex powder room, so we can apply everything there.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay!
Cosmetics Department

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Let's see... Colore Mi should be somewhere around here...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
...!
This is astounding...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Is something wrong, Aoyagi?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, nothing's wrong... I couldn't help but feel somewhat stunned since I'd only ever seen this area from afar.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I didn't realize cosmetics came in so many different shapes and sizes. There appears to be a countless number of these makeup pens alone.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I was surprised my first time too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The thing is, a lot of these look the same, but they all have their uses. Like coloring in your brows or lining your eyes.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: These liquids and gels go on differently depending on what was used to make them. We'll discuss those in more detail when we decide which to buy...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, Haruka...
This eye shadow palette apparently includes some limited edition Valentine's Day colors.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, this chocolate-colored one's really cute. It goes perfectly with our theme, so why don't we get it?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: One is more brown and the other is more orange. Which should we choose...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Well, you seem like the cool and collected type, so the brown one might help us achieve that dark chocolate look I mentioned earlier.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Plus, your skin tone calls for a more subdued color.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
My skin tone...?
I didn't realize we had to take that into consideration. You really do know quite a lot about this subject.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Only because of work.
But I'm glad this has all come in handy.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Anyway, let's start grabbing whatever else we need.
Powder Room

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I think we have all the makeup we need...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, so let's start applying it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Sorry, before we do...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Would it be alright if I tried doing it myself first?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I don't know how I'll do, but I always like to try new things whenever possible...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yes, of course.
Then, I'll show you what to do and you can copy me.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you. I'll try my best.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Good...
Your eye shadow has a nice gradation to it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Really? Thank goodness.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow... That eye shadow alone makes you look like a completely different person.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's designed to make your eyes look more three-dimensional, and a bit of eyeliner should help reinforce that illusion.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That involves literally drawing right around your eyes and eyelashes, right? I'm really not sure how I'm going to do with that...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Gel liners like these are pretty easy to use, so you don't have to worry. There's also a simple trick to getting the lines you want.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And finish by using the brush to put on a thin layer of lipgloss.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: How do I look...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I think you look great!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I... I did it...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Nice work, Aoyagi!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you...
I didn't realize just how much concentration putting on makeup requires.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
It does involve quite a lot of intricate work.
But you did an amazing job considering it was your first time.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Only because you were such a good teacher, Kiritani. Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. You're welcome.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then, I guess we can start taking some pictures...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Haruka did such an amazing job...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Not only did she find makeup that goes with Valentine's Day, she made sure they'd look good on Aoyagi...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (And he did an unbelievable job of doing his own makeup.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(I can't let their efforts go to waste.
I need to take the best photos I can...!)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You already chose a site for us, right, Azusawa?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yes!
I had a few places in mind, but based on your makeup...
